subsystems.name: Confinement core
subsystems.role: holds the fusing plasma — either a magnetic torus or a chamber where tiny fuel capsules are compressed by lasers.

subsystems.name: First wall and breeding blanket
subsystems.role: catches the fusion neutrons, turns their energy into heat and manufactures fresh tritium fuel from lithium.

subsystems.name: Tritium plant and fuel cycle
subsystems.role: extracts bred tritium, separates isotopes, stores fuel and keeps the radioactive inventory contained.

subsystems.name: Heat transfer and power conversion
subsystems.role: moves blanket heat to a turbine or Brayton cycle and produces electricity.
parts: steam turbine or supercritical CO₂ cycle

subsystems.name: Remote maintenance and shielding
subsystems.role: services a machine that becomes radioactive, so no one can stand inside it.

subsystems.name: Control and grid interface
subsystems.role: keeps the plasma stable and the output steady enough for a transmission network.

buildSteps.title: Site and license it
buildSteps.detail: A host regulator must be satisfied on seismic safety, tritium release scenarios and waste handling; a strong grid connection is chosen nearby.

buildSteps.title: Build the confinement core
buildSteps.detail: Either a torus with coils wound from superconducting tape, cooled to near absolute zero, or a hall of high-energy laser lines and a target factory — both built to millimetre tolerances.

buildSteps.title: Line the first wall
buildSteps.detail: Armour panels facing the plasma are fitted, chosen to tolerate years of 14 MeV neutron bombardment.

buildSteps.title: Insert the breeding blanket
buildSteps.detail: Modules packed with lithium-ceramic pebbles and a neutron multiplier slide into place around the vessel, each one removable by machine.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the tritium plant
buildSteps.detail: Isotope separation, storage beds and double-walled piping are installed; this is a radiochemical facility attached to a power plant, not a simple fuel tank.

buildSteps.title: Connect heat extraction and generation
buildSteps.detail: Coolant loops carry several hundred degrees of heat to exchangers, then to a turbine or Brayton cycle and a generator.

buildSteps.title: Fit remote handling
buildSteps.detail: Robotic arms and rails are installed so that blanket and divertor modules can be swapped without people entering the activated core.

buildSteps.title: Start up in stages
buildSteps.detail: Operation begins with hydrogen, moves to deuterium, and only then introduces tritium, conditioning the walls between steps.

buildSteps.title: Close the fuel cycle and export power
buildSteps.detail: The plant must breed more tritium than it burns and, once self-sufficient, run steadily while sending electricity to the grid.

prerequisites.why: fields around 20 tesla have been demonstrated, which is what makes a compact, affordable torus credible.

prerequisites.tech: Net fusion gain and long-pulse control
prerequisites.why: an inertial facility produced more fusion energy than the driver delivered in December 2022, but magnetic machines have not matched that and none runs for hours.
no tested material has been shown to survive years of intense fusion neutron flux without swelling or cracking.

prerequisites.tech: Tritium breeding and handling at power-plant scale
prerequisites.why: a plant must breed its own fuel with a breeding ratio above one, and no integrated breeding blanket has yet been operated.
tools exist from fission plants and tokamak trials, but not at the reliability a continuously operating plant needs.

pathway.milestone: ITER is being assembled in France, the JET tokamak set a 59-megajoule record in 2021 before shutting down in 2023, and private compact tokamaks are under construction.
pathway.unlocks: burning-plasma physics and industrial supply chains at power-plant scale.

pathway.milestone: a magnetic machine demonstrates fusion energy output greater than the heating energy absorbed, at pilot scale.
pathway.unlocks: confidence that the physics scales, plus the data to design blankets and shielding.

pathway.milestone: demonstration plants that breed their own tritium and deliver first electricity to a grid.
pathway.unlocks: proof that materials, fuel self-sufficiency and remote maintenance work together.

pathway.milestone: commercial fleets with settled licensing, waste routes and financing.
pathway.unlocks: firm low-carbon baseload power, if the engineering problems and costs are tamed.
